:::{#thm-entropy-discrete-nonnegative}
#### Entropy of a discrete random variable is nonnegative

Let $X$ be a [discrete random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-discrete-rv).
Then

$$\entropyf{X} \ge 0.$$

:::

::: proof

For each value $x$ with $\P(X=x) > 0$,
the [probability](probability-basics.qmd#def-probability) satisfies $\P(X=x) \le 1$,
so $\log \P(X=x) \le 0$.
Hence the [surprisal](#def-surprisal) $\surprisalf{x} = -\log \P(X=x)$ is nonnegative.
The [expectation](#def-expectation) of a nonnegative [random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-random-variable) is nonnegative,
so $\entropyf{X} = \E{\surprisalf{X}} \ge 0$.

:::
